# Remaining non-Card widget host and target evidence

This is the second integration handover for the four report families ListView, ChartView, SummaryView and DynamicListView. Read it with [report-widget-construction-corpus.md](report-widget-construction-corpus.md). The earlier 184 report graphs are unchanged and are not repeated here. This document captures static host and target-state mechanisms; it does not decide the skill scope.

All evidence came from static local source inspection. No database connection, SQL execution, browser testing, deployment, skill edit, application edit, or independent-agent test occurred. No Card registry, placement or implementation evidence is included. The TabSummaryView source path contains a historical UI-folder name; its content is the report-backed DynamicListView summary renderer. Dynamic window (DynamicView) is a separate discriminator and is outside this four-family capture.

## Findings that change the previous gap description

The permission mechanism is static evidence; the user permissions it consumes are target facts. The previous broad suggestion to collect licence/feature data should be narrowed to the actual module rows and predicates documented here. No distinct widget licence contract was found. A report-source label is not sufficient permission evidence: metadata on the underlying model property matters, including inherited metadata. This handover therefore includes the literal PermissionKey declarations rather than asking a target snapshot to invent static mappings.

Create widget exists on Dashboard.getActions, but the page must attach those actions. Construction does not prove action visibility or even mounting: tradingCompanyFooter is never mounted. The consignment jobTemplate branch is mounted but its sibling branch alone attaches getActions. Host rows include action predicates so an action found elsewhere in a method is not interpreted as unconditional. Report items on a host without Create widget still use the same saved-array loader; whether to support SQL placement there is a product decision.

Dashboard.checkPermissions is not a universal whole-widget hide rule. The ordinary report renderers use getCanView; DynamicListView sets each tab permitted=true before rendering, then the summary and list apply their own display checks. Property getCanView commonly uses canUser(view), which tests key presence, whereas Dashboard path checks use read. Queries can execute before display checks. The skill must not describe these visibility checks as database row security.

## Minimum target-snapshot contract

The following is a proposed offline interchange contract, not an existing application API or a request to export live data now. Required means required for the selected operation. Use string IDs (including bigint values), preserve null, booleans and JSON arrays, and attach an explicit completeness scope to each collection. An empty complete collection proves absence; an omitted collection means unknown. Do not supply passwords, tokens or unrelated records.

| Field | Minimum content and meaning | Required when / why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| target.databaseName | Application schema identifier for eventual qualified SQL | Any SQL preview; no connection details required |
| subjects[] | userId; effectivePermissions: {permissionKey:{type,description,read,write}} after setPermissions; selectedTradingCompanyId | Every intended owner/viewer/recipient. Preserve superuser entry existence separately from its read/write bits. Prefix and Fields-group checks need type/description. |
| permissionEvidence (alternative) | security_permission(unique_key, permission_type, description), security_group_permission(security_permission_key,security_group_id,can_read,can_write), security_group_member(security_group_id,user_id) | Only if effectivePermissions is not supplied; apply embedded OR aggregation and module filtering. Group names and generic role labels alone are insufficient. |
| modules[] | SystemAdminSetting rows with unique_key, group_name, value_boolean for group_name=Modules; complete set or explicit absent keys | Every availability decision. Keys systemAdmin/opportunity, project, serviceContract, warehouse, humanResource, accounting, consignment. Missing setting differs from explicit enabled; superuser override and ignoreSuperUser must be applied. |
| hostRequest | catalogue call-site/component, exact runtime hostName, desired route, operation, intended owner and recipients | All operations; friendly title alone cannot identify an attachment target. BranchDetails resolves supplied name from its two caller records. |
| runtimeContext | entity; id OR ids OR neither; entityOf where supplied; parameter values and selected tradingCompanyId | When evaluating one record/ID-set host. Normally runtime IDs are NOT persisted in the layout. Empty ids is distinct from absent ids. |
| recordAdmissionFacts | existence and only the record properties/relations used by applicable admission and host predicates, or explicitly attested predicate results keyed by source location | Record hosts: e.g. tradingCompany relation, Job isTemplate, type.category, timeManaged, allowTimeToBeBooked, masterJob.timeManaged; Project salesOrders IDs for the ID-set host. No bulk business data required. |
| customFields | per relevant table_name: complete rows {id,table_name,data_type,label}; options {id,custom_field_id,label}; CustomFieldSettings.maximum_quantity or explicit absent record; effective application maximum | When selecting custom fields. ORDER BY id maps slot N to the Nth field for the table. Paths remain _Custom Field NN; user label is a heading, not a replacement stored path. Supply all earlier rows needed to prove ordinal, not only the chosen field. |
| customFieldValueSamples (optional) | Only requested record/field values: custom_field_id, relation ID, text_value, number_value, date_value, custom_field_option_id | Not required to construct a generic widget. Required only if a specific example/filter operand cannot be resolved from definitions/options and user input. |
| dictionaryTerms | complete default_term -> preferred_term map for relevant terms, or explicit no override; at least Customer and Job when those expression paths are used | Dictionary-dependent graph labels and preferred widget headings. Unknown override cannot be treated as absence. |
| configurations[] | dashboard_configuration: id, created, user_id (nullable), dashboard_name, exact configuration JSON text | All matching owner/host rows, selected-row IDs, factory rows when cloning, and intended alternative layouts. Preserve every unrelated array member. |
| dashboardRelations[] | dashboard_user_relation: id,user_id,dashboard_configuration_id,relation_dashboard,is_active,dashboard_created_user_id,created | All rows relevant to the user/host or referenced configuration. Multiple active rows or dangling configuration IDs require rejection/explicit resolution. |
| configurationNameIndex[] | All existing dashboard names with IDs and user IDs, or an authoritative name-availability result for the proposed name | Creating a named alternative: saveDashboard compares lowercase names across all rows, not just owner. |
| templates[] | dashboard_widget_template: id,creator_id,type,subtype,name,configuration,requires_id,created | When selecting/adapting/storing templates. Picker filters type/subtype and requires_id; it does not filter by creator. |
| sharedWidgets[] | shared_widget_relation: id,name,from_user_id,to_user_id,dashboard_configuration_id,parent_dashboard_configuration_relation,shared_configuration and applicable audit columns | Sharing or importing. This is an offered configuration, not an automatic insertion into recipient layout. |
| recipientEligibility[] | userId and matching Person/Employee relationship with Employee.active, or attested eligibility; target permissions/modules for each recipient | When following the UI recipient selection rules. Dashboard sharing also excludes users with the selected same-name configuration. |
| restoreConfigurations[] | dashboard_restore_configuration: id,user_id,dashboard_name,configuration,created | Only restore/backup-preservation operations or matching wizard-finish behavior. Not a prerequisite to every new widget preview. |
| referenceChoices[] (conditional) | Verified IDs/labels or explicit scalar operands for any requested filter whose payload references target records | Only for filter operands that user input and static filter contracts cannot identify; no need to export every report row. |
| completeness | For each collection: supplied scope and complete true/false; explicit unavailable reason where necessary | Allows offline rejection of unknown facts instead of inventing collisions, terms, field ordinals or permissions. |

Static type choices are text, number, nullableSelect and date. Reports read values through CustomFieldData COALESCE(text_value,number_value,date_value,option label); they do not need all stored values merely to construct columns. DEFAULT_MAX_CUSTOM_FIELDS is 10, while Application loading falls back to 1 when no settings record exists. Several ReportQuery callers omit the application maximum and therefore use their constructor default; above-default slots require a proven matching consumer, not just a high configured limit. Preferred field labels never replace the stable numbered graph label.

## Persistence and attachment contract

P1 applies to every mounted Dashboard host in the catalogue. Lookup is (a) active DashboardUserRelation for current user + relationDashboard equal to host name; if found load its dashboardConfigurationId, otherwise (b) DashboardConfiguration for current user + name; if absent (c) clone the null-user factory JSON for that name, or an empty array, into a new user row. Neither query contains a current business-record ID. An active relation can select a differently named saved layout. Multiple matches have no explicit ordering; require unambiguous snapshot rows. A dangling selected ID can fall into default creation while the dangling relation remains, so do not emulate this as a sound selection strategy.

The actual loaded configuration object is rewritten from DashboardItem children on add/remove/save. Preserve unrelated items and use the exact selected row ID; appending only to the owner/name fallback can change a layout that is not displayed. Layout is widget.item, including grid position/size; require existing layout data to avoid accidental overlap. A named host can be instantiated on many record routes or more than once in a page. Each instance receives its own runtime context while sharing the same user/name or selected-row persistence key. Multiple hosts overwrite Application.currentDashboard/defaultDashboard/sharedWidgetOptions during builds; global Save/Share actions consume those mutable fields. Do not infer that the last global value always belongs to the visually intended host. Explicit row and host identity is essential.

Creating a new alternative layout follows saveDashboard: save copied JSON under a new name/current user, deactivate that user/host relations, then add an active relation to the new ID with dashboardCreatedUserId. This is a selectable alternative to an existing source host, not creation of a new application route. The name check scans all existing dashboard names case-insensitively. Share dashboard creates a separate copy for each recipient and a relation with isActive left at its model default false. It does not switch the recipient immediately. Factory rows (user=null) are shared defaults; changing one does not update already cloned rows.

Share widget saves one serialized item in SharedWidgetRelation. Dashboard loads offers by toUser + parentDashboardConfigurationRelation=host name. The shared picker parses that JSON, and finishing the wizard emits an item to the current host. The offer itself is not a persisted recipient widget. shareWidget obtains the parent name through an unscoped findOne by source configuration ID if a relation exists; snapshot ambiguity must be rejected. Revalidate source/path/context suitability for the recipient, even if the shared picker suppresses the ordinary selector steps.

Templates are a separate table of serialized items. The picker selects type, chart subtype where relevant, and requiresId=false only when there is no singular context.id. It does not validate matching host entity by itself; stored paths still need validation. context.ids is not context.id. Template creation derives requiresId from selected list/chart entity versus context.entity, not simply from page being a detail page. Some family branches do not assign it even though the model marks the column nonnullable; do not promise generic template creation for those branches.

Wizard finish writes a restore snapshot using user + dashboardName, whereas the actual displayed saved layout may have been selected by relation under another name. Existing restore rows cause direct access to defaultConfig.configuration. Guard this mismatch for selected alternatives. Restore/import logic and its relation activation are embedded so later integration can choose explicit support; it must not silently conflate restore, switching layout, cloning and sharing.

## Host catalogue and availability

S0: no context, use getSourceTables with host-name special cases such as myhr. S1: context.entity with no singular id, wizard fixes source to that entity; ids can still scope runtime queries. S2: singular current-record id, wizard traverses the host relation graph to a selectable related collection. Exact picker/reverse-path mechanics are already embedded in the first handover. All cases still require compatible graph paths, permissions and target facts.

Each row is a call site, not a unique saved-layout name. Route predicates include inherited Application/module routes and the local host/action conditions in the following records. Listed routes preserve source spelling/case. An empty route on an ancestor is a fallback Route, not proof of universal availability. ## Admission, routing and similar-component boundary inventory

Record admission predicates may prevent a component from reaching host construction even when a menu/route exists. Apply these before the local host predicates. The following literals include the decisive record/company checks; actual values are snapshot requirements. ConfigurableListView stores a separate list configuration, not a dashboard item array. DocumentModule is not a generic widget host. These call sites are classified only to avoid inserting into the wrong persistence mechanism.

````json
{
  "admission": [
    {
      "file": "server/application/bank/view/index.ts",
      "component": "BankAccountView",
      "predicate": "!bankAccount || (bankAccount.tradingCompany && bankAccount.tradingCompany.id !== application.getTradingCompany().id)",
      "evidence": "server/application/bank/view/index.ts:34"
    },
    {
      "file": "server/application/callLog/view/index.ts",

    },
````

## Proposed support boundary (decision aid only)

- Candidate: report-backed items on an explicitly identified, mounted Dashboard host with a supplied unambiguous layout selection and target eligibility facts. Dashboard and record-detail contexts both qualify technically.
- Explicit limitation: render-only hosts without Create widget; reused host names; multiple hosts in one page; ID-set contexts; context-aware templates/sharing; custom-field slots beyond the consumer default. Their source is captured so the user can decide whether the skill should support them.
- Unsuitable: tradingCompanyFooter at the captured call site, because it is not mounted; configurable-list/document components as targets for dashboard-array insertion. Creating a row does not create a route.
- Guard the earlier corpus hazards: ordinary cross-entity SummaryView empty path; missing SummaryView.list; duplicate display paths; callback/ORM target disagreements; dictionary-dependent graph labels; advertised grouping without implementation.
- Require target facts rather than infer user access, module enablement, record/company membership, custom-field order, preferred dictionary terms, recipient eligibility or active layout selection. Query/display checks are not a security boundary that SQL injection bypasses.

### E005 Permission, module and current-layout runtime / setPermissions

server/application/index.ts:551-589

````typescript
private async setPermissions(): Promise<void> {
        const userPermissions: Permissions = {}

        if (this.user) {
            const groupPermissionsQuery = getRepository(SecurityPermission)
                .createQueryBuilder('sp')
                .innerJoinAndSelect('security_group_permission', 'sgp', 'sp.unique_key = sgp.security_permission_key')
                .leftJoinAndSelect('security_group_member', 'sgm', 'sgp.security_group_id = sgm.security_group_id')
                .where('sgm.user_id = :userId', { userId: this.user.id })

            const permissions = await groupPermissionsQuery.getRawMany()

            for (const permission of permissions) {
                if (userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key]) {
                    userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key].read = userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key].read || permission.sgp_can_read === 1
                    userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key].write = userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key].write || permission.sgp_can_write === 1
                } else {
                    userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key] = {
                        type: permission.sp_permission_type,
                        description: permission.sp_description,
                        read: permission.sgp_can_read === 1,
                        write: permission.sgp_can_write === 1
                    }
                }
            }

            this.permissions = userPermissions

            if (!this.isASuperUser()) {
                for (const permission of permissions) {
                    const allowed = this.isPermissionAllowed(permission.sp_unique_key)

                    if (!allowed) {
                        delete this.permissions[permission.sp_unique_key]
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
````

### E007 Permission, module and current-layout runtime / isPermissionAllowed

server/application/index.ts:598-649

````typescript
public isPermissionAllowed(permissionKey: string): boolean {
        if (this.isASuperUser()) {
            return true
        }

        let permissionAllowed = true
        const optionalModules: OptionalModule[] = ['opportunity', 'project', 'serviceContract', 'warehouse', 'humanResource']
        const optionalModulesShortened = optionalModules.map(key => key.slice(0, -1))

        if (
            !this.isModuleEnabled('warehouse') &&
            (
                (permissionKey === 'batch/menu/locations' || permissionKey === 'productUnit/fields/productLocation') ||
                (
                    permissionKey.toLowerCase().startsWith('product/') &&
                    permissionKey.toLowerCase().includes('location') &&
                    !permissionKey.toLowerCase().includes('allocation')
                )
            )
        ) {
            permissionAllowed = false
        }

        if (
            !this.isModuleEnabled('serviceContract') &&
            (
                permissionKey.toLowerCase().includes('asset') ||
                permissionKey.toLowerCase().includes('supportticket') ||
                permissionKey.toLowerCase().startsWith('site')
                // startsWith used to prevent 'product/actions/addBillOfMaterialsItem' being included: part is 'sIte'
            )
        ) {
            permissionAllowed = false
        }

        for (const [index, module] of optionalModules.entries()) {
            if (permissionKey.toLowerCase().includes(optionalModulesShortened[index]) && !this.isModuleEnabled(module)) {
                permissionAllowed = false
                break
            }
        }

        if (permissionKey === 'product/fields/locationWhenNoWarehouseModule') {
            if (this.isModuleEnabled('warehouse')) {
                permissionAllowed = false
            } else {
                permissionAllowed = true
            }
        }

        return permissionAllowed
    }
````

### E011 Permission, module and current-layout runtime / canUser

server/application/index.ts:667-689

````typescript
public canUser(requiredAccess: FieldPermissionAccess, permissionKey: string | undefined): boolean {
        if (permissionKey === undefined) {
            return true
        }

        const regex = new RegExp('/', 'g')
        const searchKeys = ['superuser', permissionKey]

        while (regex.exec(permissionKey)) {
            searchKeys.push(`${permissionKey.substring(0, regex.lastIndex - 1)}`)
        }

        switch (requiredAccess) {
            case 'read':
                return searchKeys.filter(permissionKey => this.permissions[permissionKey] && this.permissions[permissionKey].read).length > 0

            case 'write':
                return searchKeys.filter(permissionKey => this.permissions[permissionKey] && this.permissions[permissionKey].write).length > 0

            default:
                return searchKeys.filter(permissionKey => this.permissions[permissionKey]).length > 0
        }
    }
````

````typescript
        if (ignoreSuperUser) {

        }

        return setting && setting.valueBoolean === true || this.isASuperUser()
    }
````

### E023 Source eligibility

server/functions/getSourceTables.ts:1-94

````typescript
import * as models from '../models'
import { Application, Permissions } from '../application'
import { allowedSubTables } from '../reports'
import { getReportOptions } from '../configuration'

function hasFieldKeyStartingWith(permissions: Permissions, prefix: string): boolean {
    for (const [key, permission] of Object.entries(permissions)) {
        if (key.startsWith(prefix) && permission.type === 'field') {
            return true
        }
    }

    return false
}

function hasFieldGroupKeyStartingWith(permissions: Permissions, prefix: string): boolean {
    for (const [key, permission] of Object.entries(permissions)) {
        if (key.startsWith(prefix) && permission.type === 'group' && permission.description === 'Fields') {
            return true
        }
    }

    return false
}

export function getSourceTables(application: Application, dashboardName: string): any[] {
    let sourceTables = Object.values(models).filter(model => getReportOptions(model).length > 0 && !allowedSubTables.includes(model.name))

    if (dashboardName === 'myhr') {
        sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(
            item => item.name === 'Employee' ||
            item.name === 'EmployeeNextOfKin' ||
            item.name === 'StaffDisciplinary' ||
            item.name === 'Absence' ||
            item.name === 'AbsenceApproval' ||
            item.name === 'AbsenceType'
        )
    }

    if (!application.isASuperUser()) {
        const lookup = application.getTablePermissionLookUp()
        const allSecurityPermissions: Permissions = application.getPermissions()

        if (!application.isModuleEnabled('project')) {
            sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(item => item.name !== 'Project')
        }

        if (!application.isModuleEnabled('warehouse')) {
            sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(item => item.name !== 'WarehouseLocation')
        }

        if (!application.isModuleEnabled('opportunity')) {
            sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(item => item.name !== 'Opportunity' && item.name !== 'OpportunityAdditionalCost')
        }

        if (!application.isModuleEnabled('humanResource')) {
            sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(
                item => item.name !== 'Employee' &&
                item.name !== 'EmployeeNextOfKin' &&
                item.name !== 'StaffDisciplinary'
            )
        }

        if (!application.isModuleEnabled('serviceContract')) {
            sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(
                item => item.name !== 'Asset' &&
                item.name !== 'ServiceContract' &&
                item.name !== 'Site' &&
                item.name !== 'SupportTicket'
            )
        }

        for (const sourceTable of sourceTables) {
            if (lookup.some(item => item.table === sourceTable.name)) {
                const permissionName = lookup.find(item => item.table === sourceTable.name).permission

                if (
                    allSecurityPermissions[permissionName] ||
                    hasFieldGroupKeyStartingWith(allSecurityPermissions, `${permissionName}/`) ||
                    hasFieldKeyStartingWith(allSecurityPermissions, `${permissionName}/`)
                ) {
                    continue
                }

                sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(item => item.name !== sourceTable.name)
            } else {
                throw new Error(`Table missing - details need to be added to tablePermissionLookup or allowedSubTables for: ${sourceTable.name}`)
            }
        }
    }

    return sourceTables
}

````

### E032 Dictionary override mechanism

server/functions/dictionary/index.ts:1-63

````typescript
import { DictionaryTerm } from '../../models'
import { getRepository } from 'typeorm'

interface DictionaryTerms {
    [key: string]: string
}

/**
 * Class used for the synchronous fetching of correct termionology for use in strings
 **/
class DictionaryClass {
    protected terms: DictionaryTerms = {}

    /**
     * Update the stored terms of the class to the latest database definitions
     **/
    public async setTerms(): Promise<void> {
        const dictionaryTerms = await getRepository(DictionaryTerm).find()

        if (dictionaryTerms) {
            dictionaryTerms.forEach(term => {
                this.terms[term.defaultTerm] = term.preferredTerm
            })
        }
    }

    public translate(term: string): string {
        return this.terms[term] || term
    }

    public getTerms(): DictionaryTerms {
        return this.terms
    }
}

export const Dictionary = new DictionaryClass()

/**
 * Translator function to use correct terminology for strings
 * @param term a string to be converted; if it matches a stored database term it will be translated,
 * else the term is returned as entered
 **/
export function _(term: string): string {
    const splitWords = term.split(' ')

    // Convert each word of term to uppercase to ensure translation match
    const termToTranslate = splitWords.map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.substring(1)).join(' ')
    const translatedTerm = Dictionary.translate(termToTranslate)

    if (term[0].match(/[A-Z]/)) {
        return translatedTerm
    }

    // If translated term is all capitals, e.g. VAT or V.A.T. then leave as it is
    if (translatedTerm === translatedTerm.toUpperCase()) {
        return translatedTerm
    }

    const splitTranslatedWords = translatedTerm.split(' ')

    return splitTranslatedWords.map(word => word.toLowerCase()).join(' ')
}

````

### E033 Widget-title dictionary replacement

server/functions/replaceDictionaryTermsWithPreferredTerms.ts:1-35

````typescript
import { Dictionary } from './dictionary'
import { replaceAll } from './replaceAll'

/*
 * Option 1 (default): If a prefix is not used it means that any terms are just replaced regardless of whether user wants to show them
 * or not, the code just looks for the term and replaces it.
 *
 * Option 2: If a prefix is used then all the uses in dashboards/lists/charts have to have 3 underscores added and once they changed by
 * the code they cannot be changed again because the 3 underscores would have been removed. For user to see perferred term they would
 * have to restore the dashboards.
 *
 */
export function replaceDictionaryTermsWithPreferredTerms(string: string, addPrefix: boolean = false): string {
    let replacedString = string

    if (string) {
        const prefix = addPrefix ? '___' : ''

        for (let term in Dictionary.getTerms()) {
            // This is a guard for in to prevent eslint error
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(Dictionary.getTerms(), term)) {
                if (string.includes(`${prefix}${term}`)) {
                    replacedString = replaceAll(replacedString, `${prefix}${term}`, Dictionary.getTerms()[term])
                }

                if (string.includes(`${prefix}${term.toLowerCase()}`)) {
                    replacedString = replaceAll(replacedString, `${prefix}${term.toLowerCase()}`, Dictionary.getTerms()[term].toLowerCase())
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return replacedString
}
````

### E054 Host actions and path checks / checkPathPermissions

server/component/dashboard/index.ts:66-98

````typescript
public checkPathPermissions(application: Application, model: string, paths: string[][]): boolean {
        const entity = (models as any)[model]
        const query = new ReportQuery(entity)

        for (const fullPath of paths) {
            if (fullPath !== null) {
                for (let index = 1; index <= fullPath.length; index++) {
                    const path = fullPath.slice(0, index)
                    const dataOption = query.getDataOption(path, true)
                    const dataEntityName = dataOption.getEntity()
                    const dataEntity = new (dataEntityName)()

                    const properties = []

                    if (dataOption instanceof MultiPropertyDataOption) {
                        properties.push(...dataOption.getProperties())
                    } else if (dataOption instanceof SinglePropertyDataOption || dataOption instanceof RelationOption) {
                        properties.push(dataOption.getProperty())
                    }

                    for (const property of properties) {
                        const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(dataEntity, String(property))

                        if (permissionKey && !application.canUser('read', permissionKey)) {
                            return false
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true
    }
````

### E061 DynamicListView report-summary context and permission consumer

server/component/cards/tabSummaryView.ts:1-130

````typescript
import * as icons from '@mui/icons-material'
import * as models from '../../models'
import { Application } from '../../application'
import { DATA_OPTION_NOT_FOUND, DataOption, FilterClause, FilterGroup, ReportContext, ReportQuery, entitiesToRestrict } from '../../reports'
import { Icon, Theme, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
// Import directly from the source file to prevent a circular import error
import { ListeningComponent } from '../../component/listeningComponent'
import { TabSummary } from '../../component'
import { getTheme } from '../../configuration'

export interface SummaryViewConfiguration {
    data: string[]
    entity: keyof typeof models
    icon: keyof typeof icons
    path: string[]
    title: string
    where?: FilterClause | FilterGroup
}

export class TabSummaryView extends ListeningComponent {
    protected option: DataOption<any>
    protected query: ReportQuery<any>
    protected summary: TabSummary
    protected theme: Theme

    protected entity: string

    public constructor(configuration: SummaryViewConfiguration, protected application: Application, protected loggedOnUserTradingCompany: models.TradingCompany, context?: ReportContext) {
        super()

        const entity = (models as any)[configuration.entity]
        this.entity = configuration.entity

        this.query = new ReportQuery(entity)

        this.option = this.query.addSelect(configuration.data)

        if (this.entity) {
            this.option.setEntity(true)
        }

        if (context && (context.id || context.ids)) {
            this.query.setContext(context, configuration.path)
        }

        const tradingCompanyPath = this.query.getTradingCompanyPath(this.entity)

        const tradingCompanyCondition: FilterClause = {
            path: tradingCompanyPath,
            operator: 'equals',
            configuration: { value: this.loggedOnUserTradingCompany.id }
        }

        const tradingCompanyFilterGroup: FilterGroup = {
            conjunction: 'and',
            conditions: [tradingCompanyCondition]
        }

        if (configuration.where === undefined) {
            if (entitiesToRestrict.includes(this.entity)) {
                this.query.setWhere(tradingCompanyFilterGroup)
            }
        } else if (entitiesToRestrict.includes(this.entity)) {
            this.query.setWhere(tradingCompanyFilterGroup)

            if ('conditions' in configuration.where && 'conjunction' in configuration.where) {
                for (const condition of configuration.where.conditions) {
                    this.query.addWhereCondition(condition as FilterClause)
                }
            }
        } else {
            this.query.setWhere(configuration.where)
        }

        this.summary = new TabSummary('-', configuration.title)
            .setSize('small')
            .setIcon(new Icon(configuration.icon))

        this.theme = new Theme(getTheme(entity), getTheme(entity)).addChild(this.summary)
    }

    protected getAsync(): boolean {
        return true
    }

    protected getEager(): boolean {
        return true
    }

    protected async parseResults(): Promise<void> {
        this.query.setLoggedOnUser(this.application.getUser())
        this.query.setLoggedOnUserTradingCompany(this.application.getTradingCompany())
        const application = this.getRootComponent() as Application

        const results = await this.query.getResults(true, true) // Simple total. TabSummaryView is the tab displayed at the top of a list.

        for (const result of Array.from(results)) {
            const canView = this.option.getCanView(application)

            if (canView) {
                if (this.option.getLabel() === DATA_OPTION_NOT_FOUND && !this.option.getEntity()) {
                    this.summary.setPrimary(new Typography('Data option not found', 'caption').setColor('error'))
                } else if (this.option.getLabel() === DATA_OPTION_NOT_FOUND && this.option.getEntity()) {
                    this.summary.setPrimary(new Typography('', 'caption'))
                } else {
                    const [entity, raw] = result.get(this.option)
                    this.summary.setPrimary(this.option.getFormattedValue(entity, raw))
                }
            } else {
                this.summary.setPrimary(new Typography('Access denied to total', 'caption').setColor('error'))
            }
        }
    }

    protected getWatchEntity(): string {
        return this.entity
    }

    protected entityChangeHandler(): void {
        // Do nothing. I.e. don't automatically update tab summary. It causes performance issues and crashing
        // in particular when mass uploading or deleting
    }

    protected async build(): Promise<Theme> {
        await this.parseResults()

        return this.theme
    }
}

````

### E062 Attachment operation: saveDashboard

server/configuration/global/actions/saveDashboard.ts:1-129

````typescript
import { Application } from '../../../application'
import { Button, GetURL, RadioGroup } from '../../../component'
import { Component, Dialog, Input } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { DashboardConfiguration, DashboardUserRelation } from '../../../models'
import { getRepository } from 'typeorm'

export async function saveDashboard(container: Component): Promise<void> {
    const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
    const dashboardConfigurationRepository = getRepository(DashboardConfiguration)
    const dashboards = await dashboardConfigurationRepository.find()
    const currentDashboard = application.getCurrentDashboard()
    const getUrl = new GetURL()

    const userRelationDashboardRepository = getRepository(DashboardUserRelation)

    const isCurrentRelationAvailable = await userRelationDashboardRepository.find({
        where: { dashboardConfigurationId: currentDashboard.id }
    })

    const radioGroup = new RadioGroup().setOptions([
        { value: 'existing', label: 'Update existing dashboard' },
        { value: 'new', label: 'Create new dashboard' }
    ])
        .setValue('existing')

    const confirmButton = new Button().setLabel('Update')
        .setColor('primary')
    const dashboardName = new Input().setType('text')
        .setLabel('Dashboard name')
        .setValue(currentDashboard.name)
        .setDisabled(Object.keys(isCurrentRelationAvailable).length === 0)

    const dialog = new Dialog().setTitle('Save dashboard')
        .addAction(confirmButton)
        .addChild(radioGroup, dashboardName)

    dashboardName.on('change', () => {
        dashboardName.clearErrors().invalidateCache()
    })

    application.getContainer().addChild(dialog, getUrl)

    const validateName = (): boolean => {
        const name = dashboardName.getValue()
            ? dashboardName.getValue()
                .toLowerCase()
            : ''
        const duplicate = dashboards.some(dashboard => dashboard.name.toLowerCase() === name)

        return duplicate
    }

    radioGroup.on('change', () => {
        if (radioGroup.getValue() === 'new') {
            dashboardName.setValue('').invalidateCache()
            confirmButton.setLabel('Save')
            dashboardName.setDisabled(false)
        } else {
            dashboardName.setValue(currentDashboard.name).clearErrors()
                .invalidateCache()
            confirmButton.setLabel('Update')
            dashboardName.setDisabled(Boolean(!isCurrentRelationAvailable))
        }

        dashboardName.clearErrors().invalidateCache()
    })

    confirmButton.on('click', async () => {
        const name = dashboardName.getValue()

        if (!name || validateName()) {
            if (!name) {
                return dashboardName.setError('Dashboard Name is required').invalidateCache()
            }

            if (validateName()) {
                return dashboardName.setError('Dashboard name already exists').invalidateCache()
            }
        }

        dashboardName.clearErrors().invalidateCache()

        if (radioGroup.getValue() === 'new') {
            const dashboard = Object.assign(new DashboardConfiguration(), {
                name,
                user: application.getUser(),
                configuration: currentDashboard.configuration
            })

            const defaultDashboard = dashboards.find(dashboard => dashboard.name === application.getDefaultDashboard())

            const savedData = await dashboardConfigurationRepository.save([dashboard])

            const userRelationRepo = getRepository(DashboardUserRelation)

            await userRelationRepo.update(
                {
                    user: application.getUser(),
                    relationDashboard: defaultDashboard.name
                },
                { isActive: false }
            )

            const userRelation = Object.assign(new DashboardUserRelation(), {
                user: application.getUser(),
                dashboardConfigurationId: savedData[0].id,
                relationDashboard: defaultDashboard ? defaultDashboard.name : null,
                isActive: true,
                dashboardCreatedUserId: application.getUser().id
            })

            userRelationRepo.save(userRelation)

            await application.createAuditEvent(dashboard, 'create', 'Dashboard created')

            getUrl.setRefresh(true)
        } else {
            const prevName = currentDashboard.name
            currentDashboard.name = name
            await dashboardConfigurationRepository.save(currentDashboard)
            await application.createAuditEvent(currentDashboard, 'update', `Dashboard name updated from ${prevName} to ${name}`)

            getUrl.setRefresh(true)
        }

        application.getContainer().removeChild(dialog)
    })
}

````

### E063 Attachment operation: shareDashboard

server/configuration/global/actions/shareDashboard.ts:1-181

````typescript
import { Application } from '../../../application'
import { Button, Combobox, GetURL, RadioGroup } from '../../../component'
import { Chip, Component, Dialog, FlexContainer, FragmentContainer, Icon, IconButton, Input, Select, Tooltip, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { DashboardConfiguration, DashboardUserRelation, User } from '../../../models'
import { getRepository } from 'typeorm'

interface UserList {
    data: User
    value: string
}

export async function shareDashboard(container: Component): Promise<void> {
    const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
    const repo = getRepository(DashboardConfiguration)

    const dashboards = await repo.find({
        where: { user: application.getUser() },
        relations: ['user']
    })

    const allDashboards = await repo.find({
        relations: ['user']
    })

    const editedTags: UserList[] = []

    const current = application.getCurrentDashboard()

    const confirmButton = new Button().setLabel('Share')
        .setColor('primary')
        .setDisabled(true)

    const dashboardSelect = new Select<DashboardConfiguration>()
        .setLabel(`Select dashboard to share`)
        .setOptions(dashboards)
        .setValue(current)
        .invalidateCache()

    dashboardSelect.getOptionPrimary = dashboard => dashboard ? dashboard.name : ''

    const users = await getRepository(User)
        .createQueryBuilder('u')
        .innerJoinAndSelect('u.person', 'p')
        .innerJoinAndSelect('p.employee', 'e')
        .andWhere('e.active = :active', { active: true })
        .getMany()

    const dashboardUserList = allDashboards.filter(dashboard => dashboard.name === current.name && dashboard.user !== null)

    const filteredUsers = users.filter(user => !dashboardUserList.some(dashboardUser => dashboardUser.user.id === user.id))

    const userList = new Combobox()
        .setLabel(`Select users to share`)
        .setOptions(filteredUsers.map(user => `${user.person.forename} ${user.person.surname} (${user.id})`))
        .setFullWidth(true)

    const buttonChoose = new Tooltip()
        .setContent(new Typography(`Select user`))
        .addChild(new IconButton(new Icon('Add')).on('click', () => {
            if (!editedTags.find(
                user => user.value === userList.getValue()
            ) &&
                 userList.getValue() &&
                  users.some(
                      user => `${user.person.forename} ${user.person.surname} (${user.id})` === userList.getValue()
                  )) {
                editedTags.push({
                    value: userList.getValue(),
                    data: users.find(user => `${user.person.forename} ${user.person.surname} (${user.id})` === userList.getValue())
                })

                rebuildChips()

                userList.setValue('').invalidateCache()

                validateData()
            }
        }))

    buttonChoose.on('click', () => {
        editedTags.push({ value: userList.getValue(), data: users.find(user => user.person.forename === userList.getValue()) })
        rebuildChips()
        userList.setValue('').invalidateCache()
    })

    dashboardSelect.on('change', () => {
        const dashboardUserList = allDashboards
            .filter(dashboard => dashboard.name === dashboardSelect.getValue().name && dashboard.user !== null)

        const filteredUsers = users.filter(user => !dashboardUserList.some(dashboardUser => dashboardUser.user.id === user.id))

        userList.setOptions(filteredUsers.map(user => user.person.forename))

        userList.setValue('').invalidateCache()
        editedTags.length = 0
        chipContainer.clearChildren()
    })

    const validateData = (): void => {
        if (editedTags.length === 0) {
            confirmButton.setDisabled(true)
        } else {
            confirmButton.setDisabled(false)
        }
    }

    const selectAndChoose = new FlexContainer(true, true)
        .setSpacing(8)
        .setBreakpoint('xs', 12)
        .addChild(
            new FlexContainer(true, true)
                .setBreakpoint('xs', 11)
                .addChild(userList),
            new FlexContainer(true, true)
                .setBreakpoint('xs', 1)
                .setAlignItems('center')
                .setPadding(8)
                .addChild(buttonChoose)
        )

    const chipContainer = new FragmentContainer()

    const rebuildChips = (): void => {
        chipContainer.clearChildren()

        editedTags.forEach((tag, index) => {
            if (tag) {
                chipContainer.addChild(
                    new Chip()
                        .setColor('primary')
                        .setLabel(tag.value)
                        .on('delete', () => {
                            editedTags.splice(index, 1)
                            rebuildChips()
                            validateData()
                        })
                )
            }
        })
    }

    const dialog = new Dialog().setTitle('Share dashboard')
        .addAction(confirmButton)
        .addChild(dashboardSelect, selectAndChoose, chipContainer)

    application.getContainer().addChild(dialog)

    confirmButton.on('click', async () => {
        const dashboard = dashboardSelect.getValue()
        const dashboardRepo = getRepository(DashboardUserRelation)

        const selectedUserRelation = await dashboardRepo.findOne({
            where: { dashboardConfigurationId: dashboard.id }
        })

        for (const tag of editedTags) {
            if (tag) {
                const dashboardConfiguration = new DashboardConfiguration()
                dashboardConfiguration.configuration = dashboard.configuration
                dashboardConfiguration.user = tag.data
                dashboardConfiguration.name = dashboard.name

                await repo.save(dashboardConfiguration)

                const dashboardUserRelation = new DashboardUserRelation()
                dashboardUserRelation.dashboardCreatedUserId = application.getUser().id
                dashboardUserRelation.relationDashboard = selectedUserRelation ? selectedUserRelation.relationDashboard : dashboard.name
                dashboardUserRelation.dashboardConfigurationId = dashboardConfiguration.id
                dashboardUserRelation.user = tag.data

                await dashboardRepo.save(dashboardUserRelation)
            }
        }

        await application.createAuditEvent(dashboard, 'create',
            `Dashboard shared with users: ${editedTags.map(tag => tag.value).join(', ')}`)

        application.getContainer().removeChild(dialog)
    })
}

````

````typescript
                  users.some(
                      user => `${user.person.forename} ${user.person.surname} (${user.id})` === userList.getValue()
                  )) {
                editedTags.push({
                    value: userList.getValue(),
                    data: users.find(user => `${user.person.forename} ${user.person.surname} (${user.id})` === userList.getValue())
                })

                rebuildChips()

                userList.setValue('').invalidateCache()

                validateData()
            }
        }))

    buttonChoose.on('click', () => {
        editedTags.push({ value: userList.getValue(), data: users.find(user => user.person.forename === userList.getValue()) })
        rebuildChips()
        userList.setValue('').invalidateCache()
    })

    const validateData = (): void => {
        if (editedTags.length === 0) {
            confirmButton.setDisabled(true)
        } else {
            confirmButton.setDisabled(false)
        }
    }

    const selectAndChoose = new FlexContainer(true, true)
        .setSpacing(8)
        .setBreakpoint('xs', 12)
        .addChild(
            new FlexContainer(true, true)
                .setBreakpoint('xs', 11)
                .addChild(userList),
            new FlexContainer(true, true)
                .setBreakpoint('xs', 1)
                .setAlignItems('center')
                .setPadding(8)
                .addChild(buttonChoose)
        )

    const chipContainer = new FragmentContainer()

    const rebuildChips = (): void => {
        chipContainer.clearChildren()

        editedTags.forEach((tag, index) => {
            if (tag) {
                chipContainer.addChild(
                    new Chip()
                        .setColor('primary')
                        .setLabel(tag.value)
                        .on('delete', () => {
                            editedTags.splice(index, 1)
                            rebuildChips()
                            validateData()
                        })
                )
            }
        })
    }

    const sharedWidgetNameInput = new Input().setType('text').setLabel('Widget name')

    const dialog = new Dialog().setTitle('Share dashboard')
        .addAction(confirmButton)
        .addChild(sharedWidgetNameInput, selectAndChoose, chipContainer)

    application.getContainer().addChild(dialog)

    confirmButton.on('click', async () => {
        for (const tag of editedTags) {
            if (tag) {
                const sharedWidgetConfiguration = new SharedWidgetRelation()
                sharedWidgetConfiguration.created = new Date()
                sharedWidgetConfiguration.lastEdited = new Date()
                sharedWidgetConfiguration.editor = application.getUser()
                sharedWidgetConfiguration.creator = application.getUser()
                sharedWidgetConfiguration.fromUser = application.getUser()
                sharedWidgetConfiguration.toUser = tag.data
                sharedWidgetConfiguration.name = sharedWidgetNameInput.getValue()
                sharedWidgetConfiguration.dashboardConfigurationId = current.id
                sharedWidgetConfiguration.sharedConfiguration = JSON.stringify(configuration)

                const dashboardUserRelations = await getRepository(DashboardUserRelation).findOne({
                    where: {
                        dashboardConfigurationId: current.id
                    }
                })

                if (dashboardUserRelations) {
                    sharedWidgetConfiguration.parentDashboardConfigurationRelation = dashboardUserRelations.relationDashboard
                } else {
                    sharedWidgetConfiguration.parentDashboardConfigurationRelation = current.name
                }

                await repo.save(sharedWidgetConfiguration)
            }
        }

        await application.createAuditEvent(current, 'create',
            ` Widget shared with users: ${editedTags.map(tag => tag.value).join(', ')}`)

        application.getContainer().removeChild(dialog)
    })
}

````

### E065 Attachment operation: restoreDashboard

server/configuration/global/actions/restoreDashboard.ts:1-273

````typescript
import { Application } from '../../../application'
import { Button, GetURL, InformationDialog, RadioGroup } from '../../../component'
import { Component, Dialog, Select } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { DashboardConfiguration, DashboardRestoreConfiguration, DashboardUserRelation, ListConfiguration, ListRestoreConfiguration } from '../../../models'
import { getRepository } from 'typeorm'

export async function restoreDashboard(container: Component): Promise<void> {
    const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
    const getUrl = new GetURL()
    const dashboardRestoreRepository = getRepository(DashboardRestoreConfiguration)
    const dashboardRepository = getRepository(DashboardConfiguration)
    const listRepository = getRepository(ListConfiguration)
    const listRestoreRepository = getRepository(ListRestoreConfiguration)
    const userRelationDashboardRepository = getRepository(DashboardUserRelation)

    const revertToPrevious = new Button().setLabel('Revert to previous version')
        .setColor('primary')
    const revertToFactory = new Button().setLabel('Revert to factory version')
        .setColor('primary')

    const configuration = await dashboardRepository.find({
        user: application.getUser()
    })

    const userDashboardRelationData = await userRelationDashboardRepository.find()

    const dashboardConfigurationData = configuration.filter(
        dashboard => !userDashboardRelationData.some(config => config.dashboardConfigurationId === dashboard.id)
    )

    const importDashboardData = configuration.filter(
        dashboard => userDashboardRelationData.some(config => config.dashboardConfigurationId === dashboard.id)
    )

    const listConfiguration = await listRepository.find({
        user: application.getUser()
    })

    const viewOptions = [
        { value: 'List', label: 'Restore list ' },
        { value: 'Dashboard', label: 'Restore dashboard' },
        { value: 'ImportDashboard', label: 'Import dashboard' }
    ]

    const radioGroup = new RadioGroup().setOptions(viewOptions)
        .setValue(viewOptions[0].value)

    const dashboardSelect = new Select<DashboardConfiguration | ListConfiguration>()
        .setLabel(`Select`)
        .setOptions(
            radioGroup.getValue() === 'ImportDashboard'
                ? importDashboardData
                : radioGroup.getValue() === 'List'
                    ? listConfiguration
                    : dashboardConfigurationData
        )
        .invalidateCache()

    radioGroup.on('change', () => {
        dashboardSelect
            .setOptions(
                radioGroup.getValue() === 'ImportDashboard'
                    ? importDashboardData
                    : radioGroup.getValue() === 'List'
                        ? listConfiguration
                        : dashboardConfigurationData
            )
            .invalidateCache()

        if (radioGroup.getValue() === 'ImportDashboard') {
            revertToFactory.setLabel('Import')
            dialog.removeAction(revertToPrevious).invalidateCache()
        } else {
            revertToFactory.setLabel('Revert to factory version')
            dialog.addAction(revertToPrevious).invalidateCache()
        }
    })

    const checkForData = (dashboard: DashboardConfiguration): string => userDashboardRelationData
        .find(item => item.dashboardConfigurationId === dashboard.id).relationDashboard

    dashboardSelect.getOptionPrimary = dashboard => radioGroup.getValue() === 'ImportDashboard'
        ? (`[ ${checkForData(dashboard)} ] ${dashboard.name}`)
        : (`${dashboard.name}`)

    const dialog = new Dialog().setTitle(`Restore dashboard or list`)
        .addAction(
            revertToPrevious.setDisabled(true),
            revertToFactory.setDisabled(true)
        )

    dashboardSelect.on('change', async () => {
        revertToFactory.setDisabled(false)
        revertToPrevious.setDisabled(false)
    })

    revertToFactory.on('click', async () => {
        const selectedDashboard = dashboardSelect.getValue()

        if (radioGroup.getValue() === 'Dashboard') {
            if (selectedDashboard) {
                const dashboardConfiguration = await dashboardRepository.findOne({
                    user: null,
                    name: selectedDashboard.name
                })

                const config = await dashboardRepository.findOne({
                    user: application.getUser(),
                    id: selectedDashboard.id
                })

                config.configuration = dashboardConfiguration.configuration
                dashboardRepository.save(config)

                const userRelationRepo = getRepository(DashboardUserRelation)

                const userRelation = await userRelationRepo.findOne({
                    user: application.getUser(),
                    dashboardConfigurationId: application.getCurrentDashboard().id,
                    isActive: true
                })

                if (userRelation) {
                    userRelation.isActive = false
                    userRelationRepo.save(userRelation)
                }

                await application.createAuditEvent(
                    new DashboardConfiguration(),
                    'create',
                    'Dashboard restored',
                    undefined,
                    undefined
                )

                getUrl.setRefresh(true)
            }
        } else if (radioGroup.getValue() === 'ImportDashboard') {
            const userRelationRepo = getRepository(DashboardUserRelation)

            const userRelationActive = await userRelationRepo.findOne({
                user: application.getUser(),
                dashboardConfigurationId: selectedDashboard.id
            })

            if (userRelationActive) {
                userRelationActive.isActive = true
                userRelationRepo.save(userRelationActive)
            }

            const userRelationUpdate = await userRelationRepo.findOne({
                user: application.getUser(),
                dashboardConfigurationId: application.getCurrentDashboard().id,
                isActive: true
            })

            if (userRelationUpdate) {
                userRelationUpdate.isActive = false
                userRelationRepo.save(userRelationUpdate)
            }

            await application.createAuditEvent(
                selectedDashboard,
                'update',
                'Dashboard updated',
                undefined,
                undefined
            )

            getUrl.setRefresh(true)
        } else {
            const listRestoreConfiguration = await listRepository.findOne({
                user: null,
                name: selectedDashboard.name
            })

            const config = await listRepository.findOne({
                user: application.getUser(),
                id: selectedDashboard.id
            })

            config.configuration = listRestoreConfiguration.configuration
            listRepository.save(config)

            await application.createAuditEvent(
                new ListConfiguration(),
                'create',
                'List restored',
                undefined,
                undefined
            )

            getUrl.setRefresh(true)
        }
    })

    revertToPrevious.on('click', async () => {
        const selectedDashboard = dashboardSelect.getValue()

        if (radioGroup.getValue() === 'Dashboard') {
            if (selectedDashboard) {
                const dashboardConfiguration = await dashboardRestoreRepository.findOne({
                    user: application.getUser(),
                    name: selectedDashboard.name
                })

                if (dashboardConfiguration) {
                    const config = await dashboardRepository.findOne({
                        user: application.getUser(),
                        id: selectedDashboard.id
                    })

                    config.configuration = dashboardConfiguration.configuration
                    dashboardRepository.save(config)

                    await application.createAuditEvent(
                        new DashboardConfiguration(),
                        'create',
                        'Dashboard restored',
                        undefined,
                        undefined
                    )

                    getUrl.setRefresh(true)
                } else {
                    InformationDialog(
                        container,
                        'Error',
                        `No previous version exists, the next option is to revert to the factory version.`
                    )
                }
            }
        } else {
            const listRestoreConfiguration = await listRestoreRepository.findOne({
                user: application.getUser(),
                name: selectedDashboard.name
            })

            if (listRestoreConfiguration) {
                const config = await listRepository.findOne({
                    user: application.getUser(),
                    id: selectedDashboard.id
                })

                config.configuration = listRestoreConfiguration.configuration
                listRepository.save(config)

                await application.createAuditEvent(
                    new ListConfiguration(),
                    'create',
                    'List restored',
                    undefined,
                    undefined
                )

                getUrl.setRefresh(true)
            } else {
                InformationDialog(
                    container,
                    'Error',
                    `No previous version exists, the next option is to revert to the factory version.`
                )
            }
        }
    })

    dialog.addChild(
        radioGroup, dashboardSelect, getUrl
    )

    application.getContainer().addChild(dialog)
}

````

### E072 Separate configurable-list persistence boundary

server/component/configurableListView/index.ts:1-221

````typescript
import { Application } from '../../application'
import { Base } from '../../models/base'
import { Component, Icon, IconButton } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { FilterClause, FilterGroup, ReportContext } from '../../reports'
import { ListConfiguration, ListRestoreConfiguration } from '../../models'
import { ListView } from '../../component'
import { getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { ConfigurableListViewConfigurator } from './configurator'

interface ConfigurableListViewContext extends ReportContext {
    path: string[]
}

export * from './configurator'

export class ConfigurableListView extends Component {
    protected container: Component = this
    protected hideMenu: boolean = false
    protected hideSettingsCog: boolean = false
    protected rowClick: boolean = false
    protected preserveLinksOnRowClick: boolean = false
    protected rowClickPreservedLinkLabels?: string[]
    protected hideFooterTools: boolean = false
    protected maxHeight?: number
    protected rowClickHandler?: (entity: Base) => void | Promise<void>
    protected settingsButton: IconButton = new IconButton(new Icon('Settings')).setMarginTop(-16).setMarginBottom(-16)

    public constructor(
        protected name: string,
        protected source: typeof Base,
        protected context?: ConfigurableListViewContext,
        protected where?: FilterClause | FilterGroup,
        protected rowsPerPage: number = 25
    ) {
        super()
    }

    public getContainer(): Component {
        return this.container
    }

    public setContainer(container: Component): this {
        this.container = container

        return this
    }

    public setWhere(where: FilterClause | FilterGroup | undefined): this {
        this.where = where

        return this
    }

    public setHideMenu(hideMenu: boolean): this {
        this.hideMenu = hideMenu

        return this
    }

    public setHideSettingsCog(hideSettingsCog: boolean): this {
        this.hideSettingsCog = hideSettingsCog

        return this
    }

    public setRowClick(rowClick: boolean): this {
        this.rowClick = rowClick

        return this
    }

    public setRowClickHandler(rowClickHandler?: (entity: Base) => void | Promise<void>): this {
        this.rowClickHandler = rowClickHandler

        return this
    }

    public setPreserveLinksOnRowClick(preserveLinksOnRowClick: boolean): this {
        this.preserveLinksOnRowClick = preserveLinksOnRowClick

        return this
    }

    public setRowClickPreservedLinkLabels(rowClickPreservedLinkLabels?: string[]): this {
        this.rowClickPreservedLinkLabels = rowClickPreservedLinkLabels

        return this
    }

    public setHideFooterTools(hideFooterTools: boolean): this {
        this.hideFooterTools = hideFooterTools

        return this
    }

    public setMaxHeight(maxHeight: number): this {
        this.maxHeight = maxHeight

        return this
    }

    public async rebuild(): Promise<void> {
        if (this.container && this.container !== this) {
            await this.container.rebuild()
        } else {
            await super.rebuild()
        }
    }

    protected getAsync(): boolean {
        return true
    }

    protected async build(): Promise<ListView> {
        const application = this.getRootComponent() as Application
        const repository = getRepository(ListConfiguration)

        const existingConfiguration = await repository.findOne({
            name: this.name,
            user: application.getUser()
        })

        let configuration = existingConfiguration

        if (existingConfiguration === undefined) {
            const defaultConfig = await repository.findOne({
                name: this.name,
                user: null
            })

            configuration = await repository.save(
                repository.create({
                    configuration: defaultConfig.configuration || JSON.stringify({ columns: [], groups: [] }),
                    name: this.name,
                    user: application.getUser()
                })
            )
        }

        const parsedConfiguration = {
            ...JSON.parse(configuration.configuration),
            entity: this.source.name,
            hideMenu: this.hideMenu,
            rowClick: this.rowClick,
            preserveLinksOnRowClick: this.preserveLinksOnRowClick,
            rowClickPreservedLinkLabels: this.rowClickPreservedLinkLabels,
            hideFooterTools: this.hideFooterTools,
            maxHeight: this.maxHeight
        }

        if (this.context !== undefined) {
            parsedConfiguration.path = this.context.path
        }

        if (this.where !== undefined) {
            parsedConfiguration.where = this.where
        }

        const configurator = new ConfigurableListViewConfigurator(parsedConfiguration, application).setOpen(false)
        this.container.addChild(configurator)

        this.settingsButton.on('click', () => {
            configurator.setOpen(true)

            configurator.on('save', async updated => {
                const repository = getRepository(ListConfiguration)
                const restoreRepository = getRepository(ListRestoreConfiguration)

                const defaultConfig = await repository.findOne({
                    name: this.name,
                    user: application.getUser()
                })

                const restoreConfiguration = await restoreRepository.findOne({
                    user: application.getUser(),
                    name: this.name
                })

                if (restoreConfiguration) {
                    restoreConfiguration.configuration = defaultConfig.configuration
                    restoreRepository.save(restoreConfiguration)
                } else {
                    await restoreRepository.save(
                        restoreRepository.create({
                            configuration: defaultConfig && defaultConfig.configuration,
                            name: this.name,
                            user: application.getUser()
                        })
                    )
                }

                configuration.configuration = JSON.stringify(updated)
                await repository.save(configuration)
                await this.container.rebuild()
            })
        })

        const listView = new ListView(
            this.container,
            parsedConfiguration,
            application,
            this.hideSettingsCog ? null : this.settingsButton,
            this.context,
            this.rowClickHandler
        )
            .setTitle(`${this.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${this.name.slice(1)}`)
            .on('updateSort', ({ label, direction }) => {
                parsedConfiguration.sort = { label, direction }
                configuration.configuration = JSON.stringify(parsedConfiguration)
                repository.save(configuration)
            })
            .on('updateRowsPerPage', ({ rowsPerPage }) => {
                parsedConfiguration.defaultRowsPerPage = rowsPerPage
                configuration.configuration = JSON.stringify(parsedConfiguration)
                repository.save(configuration)
            })

        return listView
    }
}

````
