### Literal server/application/index.ts:114

````typescript
export class Application extends ErrorBoundary<ApplicationEvents> {
    private readonly errorMessage: ErrorMessage = new ErrorMessage('An error occurred')
    private readonly login: Login
    private readonly passwordReset: PasswordReset = new PasswordReset()
    private readonly router: Switch = new Switch()
    private readonly loginRouter: Switch = new Switch()
    private readonly theme: Theme = new Theme({ main: '#f75db4' }, { main: '#305977' })
    private readonly appBar: AppBar = new AppBar()
    private readonly structure: Structure = new Structure().addChild(this.router)
    private readonly errorBoundary: ErrorBoundary = new ErrorBoundary().addChild(this.structure)

    private user?: User
    private tradingCompany?: TradingCompany
    private optionalModulePermissions?: SystemAdminSetting[]
    private permissions?: Permissions
    private tablePermissionLookUp?: TablePermissionLookUp[]
    private selectedRecords: Map<{ new(): Base }, Base[]>
    private userTimezone?: string
    private userTimezoneOffset?: number
    private databaseUpVersionError: string
    private maxCustomFields: number = 1 // Default is 1 so that areas that display them are not cluttered
    private debuggingSettings: DebuggingSettings
    private randomDelay: number = 0

    public FinancialSettingsModuleInstance = new FinancialSettingsModule()
    public SettingsModuleInstance = new SettingsModule()
    public currentDashboard: DashboardConfiguration
    public defaultDashboard: string
    public sharedWidgetRelation: SharedWidgetRelation[] = []

    public openSideBar: boolean = true

    public cookieDetails: string = ''
    public clientData: Client = null

    public constructor(private readonly clientId: string, client?: Client) {
        super()

        this.clientData = client
        this.cookieDetails = client.getRequest() && client.getRequest().headers.cookie
            ? getCookieValue(client.getRequest().headers.cookie, `trusted_device`)
            : ''

        this.selectedRecords = new Map<{ new(): Base }, Base[]>()

        this.login = new Login(this.clientId)

        // Inital delay to help with load. This is controlled by environment variable INITIAL_MAX_STARTUP_DELAY
        // This should be no more than 3 seconds so it doesn't cause confusion.
        // The user controlled delay is done after login and can be longer if required.
        const initialMaxDelay = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && process.env.INITIAL_MAX_STARTUP_DELAY
            ? Number(process.env.INITIAL_MAX_STARTUP_DELAY)
            : 0

        const loadingTypography = new Typography('Loading...')
        this.theme.addChild(loadingTypography)

        this.login.on('login', this.onLogin.bind(this))

        setTimeout(async () => {
            this.theme.removeChild(loadingTypography)
            this.setFallback(this.errorMessage)
            this.errorBoundary.setFallback(this.errorMessage)

            this.once('error', event => {
                // This may result in error being logged twice but is better than not at all
                console.error(`Error message: ${event.message}. Stack: ${event.stack}`)
                this.errorMessage.setPrimary(event.message)
                this.errorMessage.setSecondary(event.stack)
                this.recordError()
                this.handleFatalError(event)
            })

            this.errorBoundary.once('error', event => {
                // This may result in error being logged twice but is better than not at all
                console.error(`Error message: ${event.message}. Stack: ${event.stack}`)
                this.errorMessage.setPrimary(event.message)
                this.errorMessage.setSecondary(event.stack)
                this.recordError()
                this.handleFatalError(event)
            })

            // Add this.theme in the constructor or the app.js/vendor.js javascript won't be sent to the browser. The real content will be
            // dispatched via the publisher.hget() below. This prevents the login page being breifly displayed when already logged in and
            // refreshing a page.
            this.addChild(this.theme)

            publisher.hgetall(this.clientId, async (error, values) => {
                if (error === null && values && isNaN(Number(values.user)) === false && isNaN(Number(values.tradingCompany)) === false) {
                    const maxUsers = await getRepository(SystemAdminSetting).findOne({
                        where: { uniqueKey: 'systemAdmin/maxConcurrentUsers' }
                    })

                    publisher.scard('loggedInUsers', async (error, numberOfUsers) => {
                        if (numberOfUsers < Number(maxUsers.value)) {
                            // Fetch only required fields so that any new fields not yet added via upversion process do not cause an error
                            const query = getRepository(User).createQueryBuilder('u')
                                .innerJoinAndSelect('u.person', 'p')
                                .innerJoinAndSelect('p.emailAddresses', 'e')
                                .innerJoinAndSelect('e.emailAddress', 'em')
                                .select(['u.id', 'u.salt', 'u.iterations', 'u.hash', 'u.passwordExpiryDate', 'u.passwordIsHardExpiryDate', 'p', 'e', 'em'])
                                .andWhere('u.id = :id', { id: values.user })

                            const user = await query.getOne()

                            const databaseVersion = await this.getDatabaseVersion()

                            const userName = user && user.person ? `${user.person.forename} ${user.person.surname}` : 'details not available'
                            console.log(`After login (application index file). Number of users: ${numberOfUsers}. clientId: ${this.clientId}. User: ${user ? user.id : '?'} - ${userName}. Worker PID: ${process.pid}`)

                            // To allow upversioning of TradingCompany table it must not be fetched until upversioning is done.
                            if (databaseVersion === packageVersion) {
                                // default currency fetched so that it can be used more easily - it is used regularly
                                this.tradingCompany = await getRepository(TradingCompany).findOne({
                                    where: { id: values.tradingCompany },
                                    relations: ['defaultCurrency']
                                })

                                const customFieldSettings = await getRepository(CustomFieldSettings).findOne()
                                this.maxCustomFields = customFieldSettings ? customFieldSettings.maximumQuantity : 1
                            }

                            if (user === undefined || this.tradingCompany === undefined) {
                                this.theme.addChild(this.loginRouter)
                            } else {
                                await this.onLogin({
                                    user,
                                    tradingCompany: this.tradingCompany.id,
                                    restore: true,
                                    twoFactorVerified: true
                                })
                            }
                        } else {
                            console.log(`After login fail (application index file). Number of users: ${numberOfUsers}. clientId: ${this.clientId}. Worker PID: ${process.pid}`)
                            this.theme.addChild(this.loginRouter)
                        }
                    })
                } else {
                    this.theme.addChild(this.loginRouter)
                }
            })

            this.loginRouter.addChild(
                new Route('/reset-password/:uuid').addChild(this.passwordReset),
                new Route('/login').addChild(this.login),
                new Redirect('/login', '/')
            )

            this.structure.on('logout', this.onLogout.bind(this, true))
        }, initialMaxDelay * 1000 * Math.random())
    }

    public getCookie(): string {
        return this.cookieDetails
    }

    public async getDatabaseVersion(): Promise<string> {
        const results = await getConnection().manager.query('SELECT version_number FROM application_version')
        return results[0].version_number
    }

    protected recordError(): void {
        this.createSystemAuditEvent(
            'action',
            `System error. Message: ${this.errorMessage.getPrimary()}. Details: ${this.errorMessage.getSecondary()}`
        )
    }

    protected handleFatalError(event: Error): void {
        const delay = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? 1000 : 500

        setTimeout(() => {
            throw event
        }, delay)
    }

    protected recordDatabaseUpversion(message: string): void {
        this.createSystemAuditEvent(
            'action',
            `Message: ${message}`
        )
    }

    public getClientId(): string {
        return this.clientId
    }

    public getContainer(): Theme {
        return this.theme
    }

    public getStructure(): Structure {
        return this.structure
    }

    public async getSystemUser(transaction?: EntityManager): Promise<User> {
        const systemUserRepository = transaction
            ? transaction.getRepository(User)
            : getManager().getRepository(User)

        const systemUser = await systemUserRepository.createQueryBuilder('u')
            .select([
                'u.id',
                'u.salt',
                'u.iterations',
                'u.hash',
                'u.passwordExpiryDate',
                'u.passwordIsHardExpiryDate',
                'u.loginEmail'
            ])
            .where('u.systemAccount IS TRUE')
            .getOne()

        if (!systemUser) {
            throw new Error('System user not found')
        }

        return systemUser
    }

    public getUser(): User {
        if (this.user === undefined) {
            throw new Error('Session not authenticated')
        }

        return this.user
    }

    public getTradingCompany(): TradingCompany {
        return this.tradingCompany
    }

    public getMaxCustomFields(): number {
        return this.maxCustomFields
    }

    public setMaxCustomFields(maxCustomFields: number): this {
        this.maxCustomFields = maxCustomFields

        return this
    }

    public getUserTimezone(): string {
        return this.userTimezone
    }

    public getUserTimezoneOffset(): number {
        return this.userTimezoneOffset
    }

    public getDebuggingSettings(): DebuggingSettings {
        return this.debuggingSettings
    }

    public setUserTimezone(timeZone: string): this {
        this.userTimezone = timeZone

        return this
    }

    public setUserTimezoneOffset(timeZoneOffset: number): this {

    public async getAuditEventsFromAuditsDetails(auditsDetails: AuditEventParameters[]): Promise<Promise<AuditEvent>[]> {
        const auditEvents: Promise<AuditEvent>[] = []

        for (const auditsDetail of auditsDetails) {
            auditEvents.push(this.createAuditEvent(
                auditsDetail.entity,
                auditsDetail.type,
                auditsDetail.description,
                auditsDetail.relations,
                auditsDetail.transaction,
                auditsDetail.hideSnackbar,
                auditsDetail.systemAudit,
                auditsDetail.notLoggedInUser,
                auditsDetail.parentAuditEvent
            ))
        }

        return auditEvents
    }

    public async createImportAuditEvent(description: string, transaction: EntityManager): Promise<AuditEvent> {
        const auditEventRepository = transaction.getRepository(AuditEvent)
        const auditEvent = await auditEventRepository.save(auditEventRepository.create({
            user: this.getUser(),
            entity: 'Import',
            entityId: null,
            type: 'action',
            description,
            parentAuditEvent: null
        }))

        this.emit('audit', {})

        return auditEvent
    }

    // See AuditEventParameters interface which reflects the parameters of this method
    public async createAuditEvent(
        entity: Base,
        type: AuditEvent['type'],
        description: string,
        relations?: Base[],
        transaction?: EntityManager,
        hideSnackbar?: boolean,
        systemAudit?: boolean,
        notLoggedInUser?: User,
        parentAuditEvent?: AuditEvent
    ): Promise<AuditEvent> {
        const snackbar = hideSnackbar ? null : new Snackbar().setVertical('bottom').addChild(new Typography(description))
        let auditEvent: AuditEvent

        const constructorName = entity.constructor.name

        const saveEvent = async (manager: EntityManager): Promise<AuditEvent> => {
            const auditEventRepository = manager.getRepository(AuditEvent)
            const auditRelationRepository = manager.getRepository(AuditEventRelation)

            let auditEvent: AuditEvent

            const user = systemAudit
                ? await this.getSystemUser(manager)
                : notLoggedInUser
                    ? notLoggedInUser
                    : this.getUser()

            const hasParentColumn = await manager.queryRunner.hasColumn('audit_event', 'parent_audit_event_id')

            if (hasParentColumn) {
                auditEvent = await auditEventRepository.save(
                    auditEventRepository.create({
                        user,
                        entity: constructorName,
                        entityId: entity.id,
                        type,
                        description,
                        parentAuditEvent
                    })
                )
            } else {
                // To deal with issue that parentAuditEvent does not exist before v3.0.0
                const result = await manager.query(
                    `INSERT INTO audit_event (user_id, entity, entity_id, type, description)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
                    [user.id, constructorName, entity.id, type, description]
                )

                auditEvent = auditEventRepository.create({
                    id: result.insertId,
                    user,
                    entity: constructorName,
                    entityId: entity.id,
                    type,
                    description
                })
            }

            if (type !== 'delete') {
                await auditRelationRepository.save(auditRelationRepository.create({
                    auditEvent,
                    type: 'source',
                    [constructorName[0].toLowerCase() + constructorName.substr(1)]: { id: entity.id }
                }))
            }

            if (relations !== undefined) {
                await Promise.all(relations.map(async relation => auditRelationRepository.save(auditRelationRepository.create({
                    auditEvent,
                    type: 'relation',
                    [relation.constructor.name[0].toLowerCase() + relation.constructor.name.substr(1)]: { id: relation.id }
                }))))
            }

            return auditEvent
        }

        if (transaction) {
            auditEvent = await saveEvent(transaction)
        } else {
            auditEvent = await getManager().transaction(saveEvent)
        }

        if (!hideSnackbar) {
            this.getContainer().addChild(snackbar)
            snackbar.setOpen(true)
            snackbar.on('close', () => this.getContainer().removeChild(snackbar))
        }

        this.emit('audit', {})

        return auditEvent
    }

    public async createSystemAuditEvent(type: AuditEvent['type'], description: string, relations?: Base[], transaction?: EntityManager): Promise<AuditEvent> {
        const systemUser = await this.getSystemUser(transaction)

        return this.createAuditEvent(systemUser, type, description, relations, transaction, true, true)
    }

    public async addAuditEventRelations(auditEvent: AuditEvent, relations: Base[], transaction?: EntityManager): Promise<void> {
        if (transaction) {
            const auditRelationRepository = transaction.getRepository(AuditEventRelation)

            const entitiesToSave = relations.map(relation => {
                const propertyName = relation.constructor.name[0].toLowerCase() + relation.constructor.name.slice(1)
                return auditRelationRepository.create({
                    auditEvent,
                    type: 'relation',
                    [propertyName]: { id: relation.id }
                })
            })

            await auditRelationRepository.save(entitiesToSave)
        } else {
            await getManager().transaction(async transaction => {
                await this.addAuditEventRelations(auditEvent, relations, transaction)
            })
        }

        this.emit('audit', {})
    }

    private async setPermissions(): Promise<void> {
        const userPermissions: Permissions = {}

        if (this.user) {
            const groupPermissionsQuery = getRepository(SecurityPermission)
                .createQueryBuilder('sp')
                .innerJoinAndSelect('security_group_permission', 'sgp', 'sp.unique_key = sgp.security_permission_key')
                .leftJoinAndSelect('security_group_member', 'sgm', 'sgp.security_group_id = sgm.security_group_id')
                .where('sgm.user_id = :userId', { userId: this.user.id })

            const permissions = await groupPermissionsQuery.getRawMany()

            for (const permission of permissions) {
                if (userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key]) {
                    userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key].read = userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key].read || permission.sgp_can_read === 1
                    userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key].write = userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key].write || permission.sgp_can_write === 1
                } else {
                    userPermissions[permission.sp_unique_key] = {
                        type: permission.sp_permission_type,
                        description: permission.sp_description,
                        read: permission.sgp_can_read === 1,
                        write: permission.sgp_can_write === 1
                    }
                }
            }

            this.permissions = userPermissions

            if (!this.isASuperUser()) {
                for (const permission of permissions) {
                    const allowed = this.isPermissionAllowed(permission.sp_unique_key)

                    if (!allowed) {
                        delete this.permissions[permission.sp_unique_key]
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public getPermissions(): Permissions {
        return this.permissions
    }

    // This is to stop the permission showing if the module is disabled (including uses in all areas)
    // It relies on keys being the same and singular, e.g. Opportunity permission key and system admin key being 'opportunity'
    // Shortened keys are to deal with plurals in permission keys
    public isPermissionAllowed(permissionKey: string): boolean {
        if (this.isASuperUser()) {
            return true
        }

        let permissionAllowed = true
        const optionalModules: OptionalModule[] = ['opportunity', 'project', 'serviceContract', 'warehouse', 'humanResource']
        const optionalModulesShortened = optionalModules.map(key => key.slice(0, -1))

        if (
            !this.isModuleEnabled('warehouse') &&
            (
                (permissionKey === 'batch/menu/locations' || permissionKey === 'productUnit/fields/productLocation') ||
                (
                    permissionKey.toLowerCase().startsWith('product/') &&
                    permissionKey.toLowerCase().includes('location') &&
                    !permissionKey.toLowerCase().includes('allocation')
                )
            )
        ) {
            permissionAllowed = false
        }

        if (
            !this.isModuleEnabled('serviceContract') &&
            (
                permissionKey.toLowerCase().includes('asset') ||
                permissionKey.toLowerCase().includes('supportticket') ||
                permissionKey.toLowerCase().startsWith('site')
                // startsWith used to prevent 'product/actions/addBillOfMaterialsItem' being included: part is 'sIte'
            )
        ) {
            permissionAllowed = false
        }

        for (const [index, module] of optionalModules.entries()) {
            if (permissionKey.toLowerCase().includes(optionalModulesShortened[index]) && !this.isModuleEnabled(module)) {
                permissionAllowed = false
                break
            }
        }

        if (permissionKey === 'product/fields/locationWhenNoWarehouseModule') {
            if (this.isModuleEnabled('warehouse')) {
                permissionAllowed = false
            } else {
                permissionAllowed = true
            }
        }

        return permissionAllowed
    }

            .filter(setting => setting.valueBoolean === false)
            .map(setting => setting.uniqueKey.slice('systemAdmin/'.length))
    }

    public canUser(requiredAccess: FieldPermissionAccess, permissionKey: string | undefined): boolean {
        if (permissionKey === undefined) {
            return true
        }

        const regex = new RegExp('/', 'g')
        const searchKeys = ['superuser', permissionKey]

        while (regex.exec(permissionKey)) {
            searchKeys.push(`${permissionKey.substring(0, regex.lastIndex - 1)}`)
        }

        switch (requiredAccess) {
            case 'read':
                return searchKeys.filter(permissionKey => this.permissions[permissionKey] && this.permissions[permissionKey].read).length > 0

            case 'write':
                return searchKeys.filter(permissionKey => this.permissions[permissionKey] && this.permissions[permissionKey].write).length > 0

            default:
                return searchKeys.filter(permissionKey => this.permissions[permissionKey]).length > 0
        }
    }

    public isModuleEnabled(module: OptionalModule, ignoreSuperUser: boolean = false): boolean {
        const setting = this.optionalModulePermissions.find(setting => setting.uniqueKey === `systemAdmin/${module}`)

        if (ignoreSuperUser) {
            return setting && setting.valueBoolean === true
        }

        return setting && setting.valueBoolean === true || this.isASuperUser()
    }

    public isASuperUser(): boolean {
        return ['superuser'].filter(permissionKey => this.permissions[permissionKey]).length > 0
    }

    }

    private addRestrictedMenuesAndRoutesUsedDuringSetUp(): void {
        if (this.canUser('view', 'mainmenu/company')) {
            if (this.canUser('view', 'generalSettings')) {
                this.structure.getMenu().addCompanyItem(
                    new MenuItem('General Settings').setTo('/company/settings'),
                    new MenuItem(_('Trading Companies')).setTo('/company/companies'),
                    new MenuItem('Users').setTo('/company/users')
                )

                this.router.addChild(
                    new Route('/company/settings').addChild(this.SettingsModuleInstance),
                    new Route('/company/companies').addChild(new TradingCompanyModule()),
                    new Route('/company/users').addChild(new UserModule())
                )
            }
        }

        if (this.canUser('view', 'mainmenu/financials')) {
            this.structure.getMenu().addFinancialsItem(
                new MenuItem('Financial Settings').setTo('/financials/financialSettings')
            )

            this.router.addChild(
                new Route('/financials/financialSettings').addChild(this.FinancialSettingsModuleInstance)
            )
        }
    }

    private setRedirectAndErrors(): void {
        this.router.addChild(
            new Redirect('/my/mydesk', '/'),
            new Route().addChild(new ErrorModule())
        )
    }

    private clearRoutesAndStructure(): void {
        this.router.clearChildren()
        this.errorBoundary.removeChild(this.structure)
        this.structure.getMenu().clear().clearChildren()
        this.theme.removeChild(this.errorBoundary)
    }

    private reAddRoutesAndMenuesToStructure(): void {
        this.structure.addChild(this.router).invalidateCache()
        this.errorBoundary.addChild(this.structure).invalidateCache()
        this.theme.addChild(this.errorBoundary).invalidateCache()
    }

    public resetRoutesAndMenusAfterSetUp(): void {
        this.clearRoutesAndStructure()
        this.addMainRoutesAndMenus()
        this.addSetUpRoutesAndMenus()
        this.setRedirectAndErrors()
        this.reAddRoutesAndMenuesToStructure()
    }

    public addSideMenus(): void {
        this.structure.getMenu().addDeskItem(
            new MenuItem('My Desk').setTo('/my/mydesk')
        )

        this.router.addChild(
            new Route('/my/mydesk').addChild(new DashboardModule())
        )

        if (this.tradingCompany.isSetUp === true) {
            this.addMainRoutesAndMenus()
        } else {
            this.addRestrictedMenuesAndRoutesUsedDuringSetUp()
        }

        this.addSetUpRoutesAndMenus()
        this.setRedirectAndErrors()
    }

    public async addAppBar(): Promise<void> {
        await this.setIdleInterval()
        const versionMenu = new Menu()

        /*
         * Memory figures in Mb to aid with memory leak debugging
         * rss = resident set size - the portion of memory occupied by a process that is held in main memory (RAM)
         * heapTotal = memory allocated to the objects, strings, and closures.
         *
         * Application children (Ch) shown to aid with memory leak debugging
         * Normally it should return to 2 - AppBar & ErrorBoundary
        */
        const versionMenuItem = new MenuItem(`Version ${packageVersion} #0`)
            .on('click', () => {
                const { rss, heapTotal } = process.memoryUsage()
                const applicationChildren = this.theme.getChildren().length

                versionMenuItem
                    .setSecondary(`(${(rss / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(0)}/${(heapTotal / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(0)}) Ch:${applicationChildren}`)

                versionMenu.clearChildren().addChild(new Tooltip(`Client ID: ${this.clientId}`).addChild(versionMenuItem))
            })

        this.appBar.addUserMenu(
            versionMenu.addChild(versionMenuItem),
            new Divider(),
            new Menu().addChild(
                new MenuItem('Profile').on('click', () => {
                    this.addProfileAppBar()
                }),
                new MenuItem('Logout').on('click', this.onLogout.bind(this))
            )
        )

        this.theme.addChild(this.appBar, this.errorBoundary)
    }

    public async addProfileAppBar(): Promise<void> {
        const profileDialog = new Dialog().setTitle('Profile').setCancelButton(true).setMaxWidth('xs')
        const application = this.getRootComponent() as Application

        const changePasswordButton = new Button()
            .setColor('primary')
            .setLabel('Change password')
            .on('click', async () => {
                await changePassword(this, application.getUser(), true, true)
            })

        const user = await getRepository(User).findOneOrFail(application.getUser().id, {
            relations: ['person']
        })

        const form = new ModelForm(user, application.getUser())

        const details = new FlexContainer(false, true)
            .setBreakpoint('xs', 12)
            .setBreakpoint('md', 6)
            .addChild(
                new ModelDetailsCardField(form, form.related('person').field('forename')).setMarginBottom(8),
                new ModelDetailsCardField(form, form.related('person').field('surname')).setMarginBottom(8)
            )

        profileDialog.addChild(details)
        profileDialog.addAction(changePasswordButton)
        this.addChild(profileDialog)
    }

    public async addAppBarAndSideMenus(): Promise<void> {
        this.addSideMenus()
        await this.addAppBar()
    }

    private async setDebuggingProperties(): Promise<void> {
        // Argument of zero is to flag this is the initial setting. Code section filtering is done in later processes.
        this.debuggingSettings = await getDebuggingSettings(0)
    }

    public async setUpAfterSuccessfulLogin(event: LoginEvents['login']): Promise<void> {
        //
        /*
         * If there is a restore this.tradingCompany will have a value and event.tradingCompany will have a value.
         * If there is a login then event.tradingCompany will have a value and this.tradingCompany MAY have a value if
         * you log out and back in again but it will not necessarily be the one selected.
         * Set trading company from database so that any changed propertiy values are available (e.g. costCodesUsed).
         * Default currency fetched so that it can be used more easily - it is used regularly.
        */

        publisher.hset(this.clientId, 'user', String(event.user.id))
        publisher.hset(this.clientId, 'tradingCompany', String(event.tradingCompany))

        publisher.hget(this.clientId, 'initialLoginDate', (error, result) => {
            if (result === null) {
                publisher.hset(this.clientId, 'initialLoginDate', new Date().toISOString())
            }
        })

        publisher.hset(this.clientId, 'lastLoginDate', new Date().toISOString())

        const lastLoginColumn = await getConnection().query(`
                SELECT COUNT(*) as count
                FROM information_schema.columns
                WHERE table_name = 'application_user'
                    AND column_name = 'last_login'
                    AND table_schema = DATABASE()
                `)

        if (lastLoginColumn[0].count > 0) {
            await getRepository(User).update(event.user.id, { lastLogin: new Date() })
        }

        this.tradingCompany = await getRepository(TradingCompany).findOne({ where: { id: event.tradingCompany }, relations: ['defaultCurrency'] })

        // Fetch user so initial getUser method in Login class does not need any relations (to help avoid problems with upversioning).
        this.user = await getRepository(User).findOne({ where: { id: event.user.id }, relations: ['person'] })

        hmrcOauthService.setUserId(this.user.id)

        if (this.user.hmrcAccessToken) {
            const decryptedTokens = getDecryptedHmrcTokenStrings('Application index', this.user.hmrcAccessToken, this.user.hmrcRefreshToken)

            const storedTokenData: StoredTokenData = {
                accessToken: decryptedTokens.decryptedAccessToken,
                refreshToken: decryptedTokens.decryptedRefreshToken,
                expiresAt: this.user.hmrcExpiresAt ? this.user.hmrcExpiresAt.getTime() : null,
                tokenType: 'Bearer',
                scope: this.user.hmrcScope,
                userId: this.user.id
            }

            await hmrcOauthService.populateFromExternalStorage(storedTokenData)
        }

        await this.setModulePermissions()
        await this.setPermissions()
        await Dictionary.setTerms()
        await this.setDebuggingProperties()

        this.setTablePermissionLookUp()
        // The application is not available until it is dispatched and getGlobalActions uses it so it will display error if not.
        // Try catch block is used to prevent the error (on a refresh) where it tries again after 5 seconds.
        // This only appears to apply on myDesk and standdard landing pages for entities - they don't trigger 'dispatch'. TODO: find out why
        try {
            const globalActionList = getGlobalActions(this)
            const globalActionLabel = globalActionList.map(item => {
                if (item instanceof IconButtonAction) {
                    return item.getMenuItem()
                }
            })

            this.appBar.setActionLabels(globalActionLabel)

            this.appBar.clearActions().addAction(...globalActionList).invalidateCache()
        } catch (error) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                try {
                    this.appBar.clearActions().addAction(...getGlobalActions(this)).invalidateCache()
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Global action error re application not being ready', error)
                    // This only happens if you refresh a refresh because the first application is lost. It doesn't seem to cause a problem.
                }
            }, this.randomDelay)
        }

        const avatar = getAvatar(this.user)
        this.appBar.setAvatar(avatar ? avatar : new Avatar())

        this.appBar.setUsername(formatPersonName(this.user.person))
        this.appBar.setTradingCompanyName(this.tradingCompany.name)

        this.appBar.setUserNotifications(new UserNotifications(this.user))
        this.addAppBarAndSideMenus()
        this.structure.emit('onLoad', {})
    }

    private removeLoggedInUser(refresh: boolean = false): void {
        publisher.srem('loggedInUsers', this.clientId)

        publisher.del(this.clientId, () => {
            this.structure.getMenu().clear()
            this.appBar.clearUserMenu()
            this.appBar.setUserNotifications(undefined)
            this.router.clearChildren()
            this.theme.setPrimary({ main: '#f75db4' })
            this.theme.setSecondary({ main: '#305977' })
            this.theme.addChild(this.loginRouter)
            this.theme.removeChild(this.appBar, this.errorBoundary)

            this.pushUrl('/')

            /* This is to trigger a refresh of the page which will clear any data that might be left in
            the application and also to ensure that if there are any errors in the login page they are cleared. */
            if (refresh) {
                const getURL = new GetURL()

                getURL.setRefresh(true)

                this.addChild(getURL)
            }
        })
    }

    // Firefox seems to treat logging in slightly different and can result in having to login again
    private async onLogin(event: LoginEvents['login'], twoFactorVerified?: boolean): Promise<void> {
        this.login.resetLoginDialog()
        this.user = event.user

        let trustedDeviceFor2Fa: TrustedDevice[] | undefined = undefined

        const hasTrustedDeviceTable = await getConnection().query(
            `SELECT COUNT(*) as count 
            FROM information_schema.tables 
            WHERE table_name = 'trusted_device' 
            AND table_schema = DATABASE()`
        )

        if (hasTrustedDeviceTable[0].count > 0) {
            trustedDeviceFor2Fa = await getRepository(TrustedDevice).find({
                where: {
                    user: { id: this.user.id },
                    expiresAt: MoreThan(new Date()),
                    revoked: false
                }
            })
        }

        this.cookieDetails = this.clientData.getRequest() && this.clientData.getRequest().headers.cookie
            ? getCookieValue(this.clientData.getRequest().headers.cookie, `${this.user.loginEmail}_trusted_device`)
            : ''

        const incomingTokenHash = hashTrustedDeviceToken(this.cookieDetails)

        const trustedDevice = trustedDeviceFor2Fa ? trustedDeviceFor2Fa.find(item => item.tokenHash === incomingTokenHash) : undefined

        const twoFactorEnable = await getRepository(SystemAdminSetting).findOne(
            { uniqueKey: 'systemAdmin/twoFactorAuthentication' }
        )

        const twoFactorValidity = await getRepository(SystemAdminSetting).findOne(
            { uniqueKey: 'systemAdmin/twoFactorAuthenticationValidity' }
        )

        let authOtpDetails: TwoFactorAuthenticationOtps | undefined = undefined
        let twoFactorOtpIsExpired = true

        const hasTwoFactorOtpTable = await getConnection().query(
            `SELECT COUNT(*) as count 
            FROM information_schema.tables 
            WHERE table_name = 'two_factor_authentication_otps' 
            AND table_schema = DATABASE()`
        )

        if (hasTwoFactorOtpTable[0].count > 0) {
            authOtpDetails = await getRepository(TwoFactorAuthenticationOtps).findOne({
                where: { user: { id: this.user.id }, isUsed: true },
                order: { created: 'DESC' }
            })

            twoFactorOtpIsExpired = authOtpDetails ? (new Date().getTime() - authOtpDetails.created.getTime()) > (60 * 60 * 1000) : false
        }

        if (
            twoFactorEnable &&
            twoFactorEnable.valueBoolean &&
            !twoFactorVerified &&
            !twoFactorOtpIsExpired &&
            hasTwoFactorOtpTable[0].count > 0 &&
            hasTrustedDeviceTable[0].count > 0 &&
            !trustedDevice
        ) {
            verifyTwoFactorAuthentication(this, this.user, true, incomingTokenHash, async () => {
                await this.onLogin(event, true)
            })

            this.removeLoggedInUser()
        } else {
            this.theme.removeChild(this.loginRouter)

            const loadingTypography = new Typography('Loading...')
            this.theme.addChild(loadingTypography)
            publisher.hdel('system:locks', 'isUpversioningRunning')

            const maxDelaySetting = await getRepository(SystemAdminSetting).findOne({ uniqueKey: 'systemAdmin/maxDelayOnStartUp' })
            this.randomDelay = maxDelaySetting ? Number(maxDelaySetting.value) * 1000 * Math.random() : 0

            if (trustedDevice) {
                const now = new Date()

                const expiresAt = new Date(
                    now.getTime() + Number(twoFactorValidity.value) * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
                )

                await getRepository(TrustedDevice).update(
                    { id: trustedDevice.id },
                    { lastUsedAt: now, expiresAt }
                )

                await this.createAuditEvent(
                    this.user,
                    'login',
                    'User logged in as trusted device without 2FA challenge',
                    undefined,
                    undefined,
                    true
                )
            }

            setTimeout(async () => {
                this.theme.removeChild(loadingTypography)
                let databaseUpdateResult: DatabaseUpdateResult = null

                // At this point we cannot use "this.isASuperUser()" because that requires TradingCompany table to be used and if the upversion
                // process needs to change it we cannot allow use of it until the database is updated to latest version.
                const userIsASuperUser = await isUserASuperUser(this.user)
                const databaseVersion = await this.getDatabaseVersion()

                const versionsText = `Database version ${databaseVersion}, application version ${packageVersion}. Worker PID: ${process.pid}`

                console.log(versionsText)

                if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' || userIsASuperUser) {
                    if (databaseVersion === packageVersion) {
                        console.log('No database update required.')
                        await this.setUpAfterSuccessfulLogin(event)
                    } else if (userIsASuperUser) {
                        console.log('Database update required.')

                        const potentialStuckQueries = await getPotentialStuckQueries(60) // 60 seconds (short because app is in admin upversion mode)
                        // Note that we could restart the mariaDB service before the upversion process to clear queries but that also clears
                        // useful buffers that take time to refill and therefore users would notice a slowdown until they are refilled.

                        await InformationDialog(
                            this,
                            'BMEWEB database version error',
                            `The database is not the same as the application version.
                        ${versionsText}
                        The database should be backed up before the version is upgraded.
                        ${potentialStuckQueries.length > 0 ? `${potentialStuckQueries.length} potentially stuck SQL querie(s) found that should be terminated before proceeding.` : 'No stuck SQL queries found but you should check before proceeding.'}
                        Do you want to update the database?`,
                            'warning',
                            async () => {
                                const tryDatabaseUpdate = async (): Promise<void> => {
                                    // Flag value is not important. Its existence is the important point.
                                    publisher.hset('system:locks', 'isUpversioningRunning', 'TRUE')
                                    databaseUpdateResult = await updateDatabase(databaseVersion, packageVersion, this)
                                    publisher.hdel('system:locks', 'isUpversioningRunning')

                                    if (databaseUpdateResult.status === 'failure') {
                                        this.databaseUpVersionError = databaseUpdateResult.error.message
                                        this.errorMessage.setPrimary(databaseUpdateResult.error.message)
                                        this.errorMessage.setSecondary(databaseUpdateResult.error.stack)
                                        this.recordError()

                                        await InformationDialog(
                                            this,
                                            'Database upversion error',
                                            `${this.databaseUpVersionError}
                                        Inform BME support.`
                                        )
                                    } else if (databaseUpdateResult.status === 'success_with_sync_warning') {
                                        this.recordDatabaseUpversion(
                                            `Message: ${databaseUpdateResult.message}\nWarning: ${databaseUpdateResult.warning}`
                                        )
                                        await this.setUpAfterSuccessfulLogin(event)

                                        InformationDialog(
                                            this,
                                            'BMEWEB Database version update warning',
                                            `The database upgrade succeeded, but print-template sync failed.
                                        Follow-up action or BME support may be needed.
                                        ${databaseUpdateResult.warning}`
                                        )
                                    } else if (databaseUpdateResult.status === 'success') {
                                        this.recordDatabaseUpversion(databaseUpdateResult.message)
                                        await this.setUpAfterSuccessfulLogin(event)

                                        InformationDialog(
                                            this,
                                            'BMEWEB Database version update',
                                            `The database was updated to the same version as the application version.`
                                        )
                                    }
                                }

                                if (potentialStuckQueries.length > 0) {
                                    await InformationDialog(
                                        this,
                                        'BMEWEB database version error - stuck queries',
                                        `${potentialStuckQueries.length} potentially stuck SQL querie(s) found that should be terminated before proceeding.
                                    Are you sure you want to update the database?`,
                                        'warning',
                                        async () => tryDatabaseUpdate()
                                    )
                                } else {
                                    await tryDatabaseUpdate()
                                }
                            }
                        )
                    } else {
                        InformationDialog(
                            this,
                            'BMEWEB database version error',
                            `The database is not the same as the application version.
                        The update process needs to be performed by a super user. Inform BME support.
                        ${versionsText}
                        Clicking CONFIRM will log you out.`,
                            'warning',
                            async () => this.onLogout()
                        )
                    }
                } else {
                    console.log('No database update required in non production mode.')
                    await this.setUpAfterSuccessfulLogin(event)
                }

                if (event.restore) {
                    publisher.hset(this.clientId, 'lastRestoreDate', new Date().toISOString())
                    await getRepository(User).update(this.user.id, { lastRestore: new Date() })
                } else {
                    this.createAuditEvent(this.user, 'login', 'User logged in', undefined, undefined, true)
                }

                publisher.sadd('loggedInUsers', this.clientId)

                const getURL = new GetURL()
                this.addChild(getURL)

                const socketId = getSocketId(this.clientData)

                getBrowserInformationAndSetConnectSocketData(getURL, socketId, this.clientId, this.user.id)
            }, this.randomDelay)
        }
    }

    private async onLogout(onIdle: boolean = false): Promise<void> {
        await this.createAuditEvent(this.user, 'logout', `User logged out${onIdle === true ? ' due to inactivity' : ''}`)
        this.user = undefined

        await this.setPermissions()

        this.removeLoggedInUser(true)
    }

    public getCurrentDashboard(): DashboardConfiguration {
        return this.currentDashboard
    }

    public setCurrentDashboard(dashboard: DashboardConfiguration): void {
        this.currentDashboard = dashboard
    }

    public getDefaultDashboard(): string {
        return this.defaultDashboard
    }

    public setDefaultDashboard(dashboard: string): void {
        this.defaultDashboard = dashboard
    }

    public setSharedWidgetOptions(SharedWidgetRelation: SharedWidgetRelation[]): void {
        this.sharedWidgetRelation = SharedWidgetRelation
    }

    public getSharedWidgetOptions(): SharedWidgetRelation[] {
        return this.sharedWidgetRelation
    }
}
````
